fields.display_title: Q1: This paper considers navigation actions as texts. However, texts are not suitable to represent high-precision floating numbers, required for robotic navigation tasks.
fields.replying_to: Replying to Official Review of Submission2592 by Reviewer wPUD

fields.display_title: Q2: The paper does not compare with strong VLA models such as OpenVLA, SpatialVLA, $\pi_{0}$.
fields.replying_to: Replying to Official Review of Submission2592 by Reviewer wPUD

fields.display_title: Q3: Lack of discussion on training-free visual grounding navigation methods, such as See-Point-Fly.
fields.replying_to: Replying to Official Review of Submission2592 by Reviewer wPUD

fields.display_title: Q4: The experiments are only conducted on CityNav, which is relatively small in scale. It is suggested to test the model on larger-scale platforms such as OpenNAV to verify its generalization ability.
fields.replying_to: Replying to Official Review of Submission2592 by Reviewer wPUD
